title: Hydrophobic phenolic/silica aerogel composites with high fire safety and strength for efficient thermal insulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43095-43105
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07166F, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhixin Wang, Yong Kong, Mengcheng Nie, Kuo Liu, Qinghua Liu, Xiaodong Shen
Hydrophobic phenolic/silica aerogel composites (PSACs) with low thermal conductivity, high strength, and superior fire safety were synthesized using a facile, self-catalyzed sol–gel process for building insulation.
